Name: Map Tokens
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds the following Content Patcher tokens (all must be prefaced with "[b]aedenthorn.MapTokens/[/b]"):


[b][size=5]Farm Coordinates[/size][/b]
[b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]FarmHouseEntryTile[/b]
[*][b]MainMailboxTile[/b]
[*][b]GrampaShrineTile[/b]
[*][b]MapPropertyTile[/b]
[*][b]SpousePatioTile[/b]
[*][b]FarmTotemTile[/b]
[*][b]PetBowlTile[/b]
[/list]
Each of the above return a tile coordinate for the farm in the format [b]X Y[/b].

If you want comma-separated coordinates instead of space-separated, add [b]Comma [/b]to the end of the token, e.g. [b]aedenthorn.MapTokens/FarmHouseEntryTileComma[/b].

If you want only the X or Y value, add [b]X [/b]or [b]Y [/b]to the end of the token.


[b][size=5]Map Property Coordinates
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]MapPropertyTile[/b]
[/list]
This token takes two arguments, the location name and the name of the coordinate-type map property, separated by colon, e.g.: 

[b]aedenthorn.MapTokens/MapPropertyTile:Farm:PetBowlLocation
[/b]
You can use [b]Comma[/b], [b]X[/b], and[b] Y[/b] with this token as above.


[b][size=5]Coordinate Sets
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]FarmHouseEntryTiles[/b]
[*][b]MailboxTiles[/b]
[*][b]WarpTiles[/b]
[/list]
These three return a set of space-separated coordinates; the first two are for farms with multiple homes or mailboxes, the third takes a location name and optional destination name as arguments, e.g.:

 [b]aedenthorn.MapTokens/WarpTiles:Farm:BusStop
[/b]
will return a list of all warp tiles leading from the farm to the bus stop.


[b][size=5]Others[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]MapPath[/b] - returns the map path to a location's map file, takes the location name as an argument (e.g. [b]aedenthorn.MapTokens/MapPath:Farm[/b])
[/list]


[b][size=5]Technical
[/size][/b]
